cancel.title: Dialog title; {{title}} is the schedule's title.
cancel.description: A canceled schedule can't be resumed; the person types its title to confirm.
cancel.type: Label over the box; <title> wraps the schedule's title, which the person types.
cancel.label: Accessible name of the box where the title is typed.
cancel.mismatch: Shown while what was typed doesn't match the title.
cancel.keep: Button that closes the dialog without canceling.
cancel.confirm: Destructive button that cancels the schedule.
